fix: code review findings (risky commands, guard, hand-off, setup, SDK install)

  -Command, cmd /c), behind sudo/doas/xargs/env/nohup and find -exec; only code

  last 3 minutes (it was always true); ".." resolves in relative paths without
  a folder; the scan walks the log unsorted and skips status-only follow-ups.
- Hand-off: a drive root is "C:\." so Windows quoting holds.
- Setup only saves (and reports) a key that looks like a TypeSafe key.
- "Install it" quotes ^ for cmd, so the SDK range isn't pinned to 0.6.0.
- The plugin opens the installed copy only when it's at least as new.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <[REDACTED:email]>
EOF
